title: ANASSA: An Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.14824v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) and large multimodal models (LMMs) has enabled a new class of agentic systems capable of integrating natural language understanding with tool-based execution. In geographic information systems (GIS), this shift is transforming traditional, expert-driven workflows into semiautonomous systems that can interpret user intent, construct spatial workflows, and execute geospatial analysis tasks. However, existing approaches remain limited by fragmented integration of reasoning, execution, and evaluation, particularly in complex, real-world environments. This study synthesizes recent advances in agentic GIS frameworks, benchmarks, and surveys to identify limitations in spatial reasoning, execution robustness, validation, governance, and evaluation. translated_title: ANASSA：一个面向空间智能的智能体AI编排框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）和大型多模态模型（LMM）的出现催生了一类新型智能体系统，这类系统能够将自然语言理解与基于工具的执行相结合。在地理信息系统（GIS）领域，这一转变正在将传统的、由专家驱动的工作流转变为半自主系统，这些系统能够解读用户意图、构建空间工作流并执行地理空间分析任务。然而，现有方法仍然受限于推理、执行与评估之间碎片化的整合，尤其是在复杂的真实世界环境中。本研究综合了智能体GIS框架、基准测试和综述的最新进展，以识别空间推理、执行鲁棒性、验证、治理和评估等方面的局限性。基于这些洞察，本研究提出了ANASSA（面向空间系统的自主神经智能体架构），这是一个智能体AI编排框架（摘要在此处不完整）。
tldr: 本研究提出了ANASSA——一个面向空间智能的智能体AI编排框架，旨在解决现有智能体GIS系统中推理、执行与评估整合碎片化的问题，提升空间推理、执行鲁棒性和评估治理能力。
en_tdlr: This study introduces ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that addresses the fragmented integration of reasoning, execution, and evaluation in existing agentic GIS systems.
